item.name: Rainbow Machine
item.howToUse: You put in 25 Gold brainrots in it
item.whatItDoes: It will start the rainbow event giving brainrots a higher chance for Rainbow mutation

item.name: Bubblegum Machine
item.howToUse: You put 10 Candy brainrots in it
item.whatItDoes: It will activate and it can give the Bubblegum trait to brainrots
item.inGameRightNow: Yes, but only if Sammy activates it. and you do not have put 10 Candy brainrots in it as it would be filled.

item.name: Fuse Machine
item.whatItDoes: It can give you one brainrot and that brainrot has a chance to get the traits or mutation from the 4 brainrots you put it in. It's by chance/luck.

item.name: Craft Machine
item.howToUse: You put 2-4 brainrots in it, depending on the recipe.
item.whatItDoes: You can craft a brainrot with a 100% chance of getting, but it required the brainrots for the recipe.

item.name: Witch Fuse
item.whatItDoes: It can give you one brainrot and that brainrot has a chance to get the traits or mutation from the 4 brainrots you put it in. It's by chance/luck.

item.name: Brainrot Dealer
item.howToUse: You spend the in game cash
item.whatItDoes: You can buy brainrots and it will spawn with a 100% chance, but only if the brainrot was in stock.

item.name: Brainrot Trader
item.howToUse: You put 1-5 brainrots in it, depending on the recipe.
item.whatItDoes: You can trade for a brainrot with a 100% chance of getting, but it required the brainrots for the recipe.

item.name: Santa's Fuse
item.whatItDoes: It can give you one brainrot and that brainrot has a chance to get the traits or mutation from the 4 brainrots you put it in. It's by chance/luck.

item.name: Santa's Shop
item.howToUse: You spend the in game gold elves or robux
item.whatItDoes: It will give you a brainrot if you buy it with robux or gold elves. but only if the brainrot was in stock.

item.name: New Year's Machine
item.howToUse: You put brainrots that is brainrot god rarity or higher in it
item.whatItDoes: It will start the New Years Event and also spawn a 2026 brainrot

item.name: Cupid's Machine
item.howToUse: Insert a specific combination of Two Brainrots to get a different reward.
item.whatItDoes: 45% Heart Lucky Block 40.25% Nothing 14.50% Cupid Cupid Sahur 0.25% Lovin Rose 0.0625% Love Love Bear

item.name: Trade Machine
item.howToUse: You choose brainrot(s) to trade with the other player, and press accept after all players have pressed ready, and once all players have pressed accept, the brainrot the other player had will go into your base, same with the other one.

item.name: Divine Fuse
item.whatItDoes: It can give you one brainrot and that brainrot has a chance to get the traits or mutation from the 4 brainrots you put it in. It's by chance/luck.

item.name: Egg Incubator
item.howToUse: You put Egg Lucky Blocks in it
item.whatItDoes: You can still get traits even if it's not on the track.

item.name: Cyber Craft Machine
item.howToUse: You put specific Brainrots to craft another specific Brainrot
item.whatItDoes: Once you give it the required Brainrots, it will start crafting for a certain amount of time (the better the Brainrot the longer it takes). Once the timer is over (or Sammy skips the craft timer), you can reveal the Brainrot.
